RequestText: CREATE SET TABLE SALES.Customers ... UNIQUE PRIMARY INDEX (CustomerId);
CREATE MULTISET TABLE SALES.Orders ... PRIMARY INDEX (CustomerId) PARTITION BY RANGE_N(...);
CREATE SET TABLE SALES.EventLog (EventType CHAR(10) COMPRESS ('CLICK', 'VIEW'), ...) PRIMARY INDEX (EventType);
CREATE MULTISET TABLE SALES.Clicks (...) NO PRIMARY INDEX PARTITION BY COLUMN;

REPLACE VIEW SALES.vLastOrder AS LOCKING ROW FOR ACCESS
SEL o.OrderId, o.OrderDate, c.Name
FROM SALES.Orders o
JOIN SALES.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.CustomerId ORDER BY o.OrderDate DESC) = 1;
REPLACE TRIGGER SALES.trgOrders AFTER INSERT ON SALES.Orders ...
CREATE JOIN INDEX SALES.jiOrders AS SEL CustomerId, OrderDate FROM SALES.Orders;
